chunks: He narrated what we mentioned: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about fasting during the days of Tashriq, so he said: As for the cities (provincial capitals), there is no harm in it, but as for Mina, there is not.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting during the days of Tashriq in Mina versus the cities?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Istibsar*, Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar queries Imam al-Sadiq (AS) regarding the prohibition of fasting during the Days of Tashriq, receiving a nuanced ruling that distinguishes between general urban areas (*al-Asar*) and the specific sacred precinct of Mina. This distinction highlights the scholarly understanding that the prohibition is particularly stringent for pilgrims performing Hajj within Mina, reflecting the unique sanctity of the site during the ritual of stoning the Jamarat. The hadith underscores the practical application of fiqh in differentiating between local customs and the specific obligations of the Hajj pilgrimage.
